name: psst
description: Please Send Smarter Thoughts: ask Sonnet, Haiku, Opus, or Fable one question from inside any Claude Code session without switching models. /psst:psst <model> <message>, or the shortcuts /psst:s /psst:h /psst:o /psst:f (/psst:sonnet /psst:haiku /psst:opus /psst:fable). Replies are tagged and short, and noisy work runs in a subagent so the session never compacts.
